name: @foldedspacelabs/metistry-artifacts
description: Publish-and-review for agent output, backed by a versioned vault: compare-and-swap publish (idempotent, attributed), comment threads on exact versions, and review dispatch that rides a shared task list — with the agent-to-agent autonomy boundary enforced in the service. One TypeScript service over any pg-shaped client and any vault client; adapters (HTTP, MCP, CLI) add nothing.
